data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 contradicts SRC_005 regarding the possibility of non-inductive action. SRC_001 asserts preference is a methodological rule grounded in verisimilitude, while SRC_005 asserts it necessarily assumes uniformity of nature. REFUTED IF Popper's concept of 'verisimilitude' can be shown to logically entail an expectation of future success, which would make SRC_001's defense collapse into the induction SRC_005 describes.
